subject: MSA + Order Form: indemnity notice routing & evidence ticketing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@praxisai.com>
Date: 2026-11-18 09:12 PST
Subject: MSA + Order Form: indemnity notice routing & evidence ticketing

Team —

Praxis returned our latest MSA redlines (attached) and pushed back on our notice/evidence flow for third‑party IP claims. Their key asks are: 1) shorten the notice window to 60 days for third‑party claims, 2) require us to retain evidence for 12 months, and 3) they want an explicit SLA for when we’ll open an internal evidence ticket once notice is received.

Can legal advise on whether we can accept a 60‑day notice or push back to 90? Also ops/CS (Marissa) — how feasible is an automated support ticket creation when legal receives a notice (we have a support webhook; can it be used to create an evidence ticket and attach the incoming notice)?

Attached: Praxis_MSA_redline_v3.docx.

Goal: align on a single proposal to send back to Praxis legal by EOD Wednesday so procurement can finalize the order form.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18 11:05 PST
Subject: RE: MSA + Order Form: indemnity notice routing & evidence ticketing

Karthik —

Thanks for flagging. High level thoughts: we should decline the 60‑day unilateral notice window for third‑party IP claims; 90 days is our baseline given the time needed to triage technical reproducibility and collect logs. That said, we can offer operational commitments to speed evidence intake:

- Proposed compromise language to offer Praxis: 90 days for formal notice, with a commitment to acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and create an evidence ticket in our support system within 48 hours of acknowledgement.
- Evidence retention: 12 months is acceptable for this customer class, but include standard carveouts for logs that exceed cost thresholds (e.g., storage > $X/month).
- Defense control: preserve right to defend, but agree to regular status updates and an escalation path if Praxis requests: they can propose counsel after 30 days.

I’m attaching a one‑page evidence intake checklist + template (evidence_template.xlsx) we can share with Praxis to standardize submissions. Also recommending we add a narrow OSS/third‑party dependency carveout: claims arising solely from open source dependency use should follow the OSS exception in Section 7.

If Marissa/Laura confirm ticketing automation works, I’ll draft the redline language.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_template.xlsx

From: Susan Park <susan@praxisai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Praxis Legal <legal@praxisai.com>
Date: 2026-11-20 08:30 PST
Subject: RE: MSA + Order Form: indemnity notice routing & evidence ticketing

Thanks Karthik/Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick read. A couple of clarifications from our side: Praxis prefers 60 days because our internal acceptance testing windows can be tight (enterprise procurement constraint). If you can give us a hard SLA for acknowledgement + ticket creation (we proposed 24 hours but can be flexible), that will help our legal and engineering coordinate.

On evidence retention: 12 months is fine. We also request a mechanism to request additional retention (up to 24 months) with reasonable notice for active incidents. Can you confirm if that is doable?

Susan Park
Head of Legal Operations
PraxisAI

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@praxisai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20 10:00 PST
Subject: RE: MSA + Order Form: indemnity notice routing & evidence ticketing

Susan —

Thanks for the note. We want to balance operational SLA with legal exposure. Proposed compromise:

- Notice window: 90 days (from date notice is first served) — our legal preference.
- Operational SLA: we will acknowledge receipt within 24 hours and create an evidence support ticket within 48 hours of receipt. The ticket will include a standardized intake form and a place to upload artifacts.
- Evidence retention: default 12 months with an option for Praxis to request extended retention up to 24 months for an active incident; extensions require a written request and cost recovery for extraordinary storage.

If you can accept the 90/24/48 compromise we will incorporate the exact clause language and send a redline for signoff.

—Karthik

Date: 2026-11-25 16:42 PST
Subject: RE: MSA + Order Form: indemnity notice routing & evidence ticketing

All —

Okay to proceed with Karthik’s compromise. Final notes for the redline I will prepare:

1) Insert clause: "Provider will acknowledge receipt of any third‑party IP claim notice within 24 hours and create an evidence ticket in Provider's support system within 48 hours. Provider will retain evidence for 12 months by default; Customer may request extended retention up to 24 months for active incidents upon payment of reasonable storage costs."

2) Add OSS carveout language: "Claims solely arising from Customer's use or modification of open source components are excluded from Provider indemnity, subject to the OSS exceptions set forth in Section 7."

3) Add operational step: include a link in the Order Form to the evidence intake checklist and require Customer to use the intake template to avoid delays. (Laura, Marissa: please confirm the Drive link and that the webhook for ticket creation will attach files and a copy of the incoming notice — if you can post a screenshot, attach it to the HubSpot task.)

I will produce the redline by tomorrow morning and attach the evidence_template.xlsx plus a sample support-ticket-screenshot.png. Procurement can then update the order form and push to HubSpot (link below).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

summary: Negotiation with PraxisAI over MSA/Order Form indemnity. Customer asked for 60‑day notice and 12‑24 month evidence retention; Redwood legal proposed 90 days with 24‑hour acknowledgement and 48‑hour evidence ticketing plus OSS carveout and cost recovery for extended retention. Operations to confirm webhook/ticket automation and provide intake checklist link. Next step: legal to send final redline and procurement to update HubSpot deal.
